title: There is an explicit link between the recommendations and the supporting evidence.

chain_of_thought.step1_locate: Recommendations section (Table 1) and Key Evidence descriptions
step2_evidence: The guideline panel rated recommendations by using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) method (11).

The VA/DoD CPG summarizes the available evidence from major clinical trials as well as meta-analyses to inform strength of recommendations (30-44) that apply to patients with both recent-onset and longer-duration diabetes with established complications.
Table. Summary of Recommendations From the 2017 VA/DoD CPG on the Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
chain_of_thought.step3_reasoning: The guideline provides clear description of evidence usage (GRADE method), references (30-44), and evidence summary table (Table 1). All three required elements are explicitly met: 1) Description of evidence usage (GRADE method), 2) Each recommendation linked to key evidence (via Table 1 and cited references), 3) Evidence summaries/tables (Table 1 explicitly listed in Recommendations section). This meets the highest scoring criteria (6-7) as all elements are clearly present with verbatim evidence links.
